description: This Java class 'ConditionValidator' is a validator for 'Condition' objects within the OpenMRS project. It ensures that instances of 'Condition' are properly structured by checking for null values and type correctness. The class implements Spring's Validator interface and is annotated with a Handler to support 'Condition' objects.

classes.name: ConditionValidator
classes.description: A validator class that validates Condition objects, ensuring that required fields are not null and that the object is of the correct type.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Determines if the validator supports validating instances of the given class.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on the provided Condition object, checking for null fields and throwing exceptions if validations fail.
